behaviour_summary: Bounded SearchIndexPort and SearchQueryPort separate write/lifecycle from read/query. Documents are tenant scoped, permission aware, and provider adapters stay behind ports.
notes: React used Postgres FTS as built-in local substrate; USF search slice should use local/in-memory provider only and defer live external search.

behaviour_summary: Search rejects empty query and documents with secret-looking metadata keys; results omit body and secret metadata.
usf_target: packages/core search document validation and safe result view tests
notes: Extended by follow-up requirements to reject object keys, recipient addresses, raw provider payloads, and restricted fields by default.

behaviour_summary: Tenant A and Tenant B with same title only see their own documents; permission gated documents are hidden without required permission.
usf_target: capabilities/search tenant/PDP checks and adapters/search tenant-scoped query
notes: USF must also prove counts, facets, cursors, and rankings do not leak cross-tenant existence.

behaviour_summary: POST /api/org/search is tenant scoped and requires tenant.search.read; admin readiness/reindex require platform.search.read/write; schemas constrain q, documentType, page, and limit.
usf_target: docs/architecture/search-indexing-and-discovery-standard.md API posture; future route surface deferred unless existing API authority is extended
notes: Current authorised USF slice may define API/OpenAPI posture without exposing broad HTTP routes.

behaviour_summary: Operator reindex is audited and returns document count; readiness is truthful, degraded when empty, blocked if store unreachable.
usf_target: capabilities/search reindex service with jobs/audit/telemetry and provider-mode-safe readiness status
notes: USF should use tenant-scoped jobs with concrete service actors and avoid live readiness claims.

behaviour_summary: Postgres search_documents table uses tenant RLS, tsvector, optional permission_key, plainto_tsquery, rank order, limit/page, and no secret columns by design.
usf_target: In-memory search adapter plus DB/RLS backstop deferred under DB depth; no new DB migration in this slice
notes: USF already has DB/RLS slice; this search slice proves local in-memory semantics and defers persistent index storage.

behaviour_summary: React admin search route is permission-gated; server remains authoritative for search and reindex controls.
usf_target: foundation tests prove PDP/search semantics; no UI implementation
notes: No UI/Playwright behaviour should disappear silently; rewritten as capability/API proof posture.

behaviour_summary: Meilisearch/Typesense/OpenSearch appear as future or composed provider posture, not as foundation live provider requirement.
usf_target: provider registry entry and standard live-external-deferred posture for full-text/vector/external search
notes: No live search provider, vector database, AI/RAG, or public search readiness claim.

behaviour_summary: React registers search proofs for runtime, tenant isolation, and route guard coverage.
notes: Proof must be hermetic/local dev/test only and include follow-up leak scans.
